jobs.title: Legal Legal Operations Associate (Remote) Toronto, Ontario
jobs.description: More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as a fundamental necessity, yet the experience of owning one is stuck in the 90s. At Jerry.ai, we are building the first app to manage it all. Since launching in 2019, we’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and achieved profitability in 2024. Jerry operates across the US and Canada, and our legal team keeps all of it running: entity filings, IP protection, product reviews, consumer escalations, and audits. The team is small, so this role comes with real scope early. You’ll run core legal operations and rebuild them with AI and low-code tools, so a small team can do the work of a much larger one. The person who succeeds in this role is a natural driver: someone who owns a project from start to finish, solves complex problems without a manual, and has the grit to thrive in a startup environment. If you are eager to sit at the intersection of law, technology, and AI-driven efficiency, we want to hear from you. Why You Will (Or Won’t) Like Working Here • Real ownership early: You report directly to our Legal Counsel and work closely with them across the team’s full scope. The projects you take on are yours from start to finish. • Room to build: Many of our legal processes are still being optimized. You’ll decide how they should work and build the systems behind them. • Building and operating: Alongside the building, a large share of the job is recurring work: filings, deadlines, and audits that have to be done exactly right, every time. Your accuracy keeps Jerry in good standing in every jurisdiction, and people who enjoy both sides of the role do well here. • Growth that tracks results: You’ll learn from leaders who come from Amazon, Better, LinkedIn, McKinsey, BCG, and Bain. Promotion is based on performance and ownership alone, so strong work moves you forward fast. What You’ll Own • Automation: Use AI and low-code tools to replace manual legal tasks with workflows that run on their own. • Legal and regulatory projects: Work with our Legal Counsel on legal research, contract reviews, and other substantive projects as new questions come up. • Entity compliance: Keep Jerry’s corporate entities in good standing across the US and Canada, handling annual reports and state requests end to end on your own. • Brand protection: Monitor Jerry’s intellectual property, find infringements, and initiate cease-and-desist workflows. • Consumer escalations: Investigate complex escalations to their root cause, recommend fixes, and turn recurring issues into compliance training for teams across the company. • Product compliance reviews: Review products and processes for compliance risk and user friction, then work with Engineering and Product to fix the underlying issue. • Compliance audits: Lead audits across operations and keep watch on the highest-risk areas between them. Who You Are • A Closer: You track every open item until it’s done, and you find the answer yourself before asking someone else for it. • A Builder: The second time you do a task by hand, you start working out how to automate the third. You reach for a spreadsheet or a low-code tool before a manual checklist. • A Zero-Error Operator: Regulatory filings and audits leave no room for mistakes, and you work accordingly. You keep your own system so no deadline or cross-functional project slips. • A Proactive Communicator: You provide updates without being chased, flag blockers early, and make sure teammates know what happens next. • Comfortable with ambiguity: You can take an unclear brief, define the problem yourself, and move on it with urgency. What You’ll Bring • A Bachelor’s degree from an academically rigorous program, with a record of high performance. • A track record of owning projects start to finish and solving problems without being told how, at school, at work, or on your own. • Demonstrated interest in using AI and technology to improve how work gets done, such as a tool, automation, or process y
